verdict.rationale: The pack shows gstack has an install/upgrade mechanism (docs-7 describes detecting global vs vendored install and upgrading; docs-16 describes a 'dev mode' symlink setup) and community discussion (comm-3) explicitly characterizes the install model as 'git-clone-and-copy' rather than a single package-manager one-liner or marketplace command. No evidence pack item shows the actual documented one-line install command or explicit confirmation that a skill becomes active in the very next session without extra steps. missing for 10: an explicit one-liner install command (npx/CLI/marketplace), confirmation of automatic activation next session, independent verification of install simplicity.
